draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base holds on the unseen test sets of the Banking and Travel domains it was trained on.
rationale: The evidence (T1.r1, T1.r2) shows Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on unseen test sets of Banking and Travel, the same domains used in training. No data covers other customer-service domains, so the claim of extension to unseen domains is unsupported; a narrower version is supported.
